headline: Romanian salary barometer 2026: Inflation reduces incomes, but IT remains at the top with over 11,000 lei per month / Candidates ask for almost 30% more than what is offered
summary: The first Romanian Salary Barometer 2026 found hourly labour cost of 13.6 euros, about a third of the EU average of 34.9 euros. IT remains the highest-paid sector, earning over 11,000 lei a month.
why: Labour costs and wage trends shape competitiveness for employers and inflation expectations for central banks and investors in emerging EU markets.
